title: No suite check pins the k <= 0 guard of tariff._smooth_topk_sum; the scalar and batch top-k disagree at k = 0 unseen
claim: Mutating tariff.py:744 `if x.size == 0 or k <= 0:` to `k < 0` (R10 C2 M31) survives the full gate: no check fails beyond the null control, although _smooth_topk_sum(x, 0) then returns 1.473806 instead of 0.0, while _smooth_topk_sum_batch still returns 0.0.
mechanism: The guard is reached only by a direct call: both production callers clamp k with max(1, min(int(bill.peaks_averaged), ...)) (tariff.py L982, L1204) before the call, so no gate script ever drives k = 0. The scalar/batch parity checks in the suite run at k >= 1 only. Behaviour in production is unchanged today; the contract stated in the function body (0 for k <= 0, matching the batch twin) is unpinned, so a caller dropping the clamp would go unnoticed.

evidence.unit: gate scripts failing more checks under the mutant than under the null control (killed_by count)
evidence.machine: local Apple M1, 8 cores, 8 GB, macOS (Darwin), venv-ci CPython 3.14.7, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1, Accelerate BLAS
evidence.contention_note: Count is contention-immune. The gate's wall time was 6820.6 s at load1 8.08..246.46, on a shared host with other seats running (provisional). The null control's red scripts ['python3 tests/closure.py selftest', 'python3 tests/entities.py', 'python3 tests/harness_headers.py', 'python3 tests/optimality.py', 'python3 tests/stress.py'] and their failed-check counts {'python3 tests/closure.py selftest': 2, 'python3 tests/entities.py': 2, 'python3 tests/optimality.py': 1, 'python3 tests/stress.py': 2, 'python3 tests/harness_headers.py': 4} are host artefacts; the mutant's profile was identical: {'python3 tests/closure.py selftest': 2, 'python3 tests/entities.py': 2, 'python3 tests/optimality.py': 1, 'python3 tests/stress.py': 2, 'python3 tests/harness_headers.py': 4}.

perturbation.change: d931_probe.py --mutant: the same one-line edit applied in memory. scalar_k0 moves 0.000000 -> 1.473806 and mismatch 0 -> 1. Adding a check that pins _smooth_topk_sum(x, 0) == 0.0 moves the gate's killed_by count 0 -> 1.

metric_definition: killed_by count of the full gate on the mutant: scripts failing more checks than the null control; 0 = no check reads the line
phenomenon_property: Every early-return guard of a tariff reduction (top-k, smooth top-k, batch twin) is exercised by at least one check at its boundary value

null_control.value: gate_rc=1, red 5 scripts (host artefacts), identical to the mutant's
null_control.note: batch_k0 is the probe's null arm: 0.0 under both arms

proposed_fix_scope: tests only: a features.py check that _smooth_topk_sum(x, 0) and _smooth_topk_sum_batch(x[None], 0) both return 0.0
